[u][b][size=4]Description[/size][/b][/u]
[size=3]Like I said, I'm not a modder or a coder - I'm just kind of bumbling my way through this, so if you find any mistakes or missing pixels PLEASE let me know. It might be a little bit until I can figure out exactly what the problem is but there will be updates for sure.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Update 10/12/2025[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]I know it's been quite some time. Sorry about that! Unfortunately I do work multiple full-time jobs and have little energy for modding (thanks, US economy!) I know there's a stardew update due to drop in the coming month(s) - I'm planning on updating and reworking the UI when that drops. Thanks for all your support![/size]
[color=#ffff00]
[u][b][size=6]How to Install[/size][/b][/u][/color]
[size=3]Drag and drop the [CP] Galactic UI from the .rar into your mods folder. That's it!
I'd recommend downloading [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Font Settings[/url] [/b]to get the font that's easiest to read for you as this UI was designed specifically for low-light and light-sensitive players. 
[/size][size=4]
